rationale: The current Facts 2.2 and deterministic Research were reviewed and approved as inputs to angle planning for this run.
freshness_rule: This approval is valid only while every current SHA-256 listed in dependency_hashes exactly matches its recorded value. Any mismatch makes this record stale and requires renewed human review.
known_limitations: Only the nine listed claims are approved for angle planning; unverified claims must not enter angle content.
Industry coverage is partial: two named increases and one decline; it is not a complete industry ranking.
Authority approval covers document-attested propositions and deterministic comparisons only; it does not approve causal, motive, market-impact, or policy-implication claims.
Household Survey and Establishment Survey scopes must remain distinct.
